lines.speaker: Lady Hesting
lines.text: You've chosen a strange season to enter society, dear. Half these houses are still counting their losses from the Hasting affair.

lines.speaker: Lady Hesting
lines.text: Names are dangerous currency at a ball, Lady Renoux. I'll only say the obligators were involved, and obligators are never involved for small matters.

lines.speaker: Lady Hesting
lines.text: An entire shipment of atium, or so the rumor goes. Enough to ruin a lesser house outright.
